title: Weapon
description: A weapon profile (FR-CBT-04 · GDD Part IX "weapons are tools with trade-offs, not power tiers"). One row per item type the player can fight with, across the improvised / bladed / blunt / firearm families. As with enemies, the engine holds the authoritative combat dials as constants (combat/weapons.ts) and these files mirror them for the schema gate and a harness drift-guard; what the REGISTERED pool actually gates is loot placement, so a run that loads no weapon content set places no weapons in the world. Damage buys noise: no profile may be at least as good as another on every axis the player pays on (damage, noise, wear, retaliation, pierce, durability, carry weight) — that is the anti-power-tier rule, and a test enforces it.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

id.description: Stable content id: the item type this profile belongs to (item.<slug>), or weapon.bare for the empty-handed floor, which has no item behind it.

name.description: Player-facing name, used in choice labels — "Strike with the firefighter's axe" (ICU MessageFormat string).

description.description: How the weapon reads in the hand: what it is good for and what it costs (ICU MessageFormat string).

kind.description: How a fight resolves it: a melee profile swings (and is what the equipped artifact must be); a firearm spends a round and is brought up out of the pack, never equipped.

category.description: The GDD Part IX family the trade-offs are authored as: improvised (everywhere, fragile, weak, quiet), bladed (reliable, quiet, wears), blunt (forgiving, durable, some noise), firearms (powerful and safe-feeling, but loud). Explosives are authored-for but unshipped — item.molotov still has no combat action (PL-M4-30).

dmgMin.description: Low end of one blow's damage. Equal to dmgMax means a FLAT weapon, which draws no RNG at all (every firearm is one).

dmgMax.description: High end of one blow's damage.

noise.description: T14 noise deposited by one blow — the weapon's real price, and since T75/T76 the term that decides what walks toward you afterwards.

armorPierce.description: Points of the enemy's armor this ignores. Firearms carry enough (3) to ignore every armor value in the game; a melee weapon that carries any is an answer to riot plate. Defaults to 0.

durabilityCost.description: Durability spent per blow by the equipped artifact — the FR-ECO-07 repair loop's drain. 0 for bare hands and for firearms, which are ammunition-fed stacks with nothing to wear. Defaults to 0.

retaliateModifier.description: Percentage points added to the enemy's answer chance. A weapon with reach keeps them off you (negative); a short, wild one puts you inside their reach (positive). Never overrides a committed swing or a fast dead's initiative — both are absolute. Defaults to 0.

accuracy.description: Chance the blow lands. Exactly 1 means it always lands and draws nothing, which is every melee profile in the shipped game. Defaults to 1.

startDurability.description: Durability a FOUND one arrives at, and the tell that this profile has a tracked artifact behind it. null (the default) means no artifact: bare hands, and every firearm.

lootWeight.description: Rarity in the weighted loot draw, read against the engine's BASE_LOOT_WEIGHT for an ordinary item. 0 (the default) means never placed by loot — bare hands, and the crafted reinforced tool, which the bench mints instead.

lootKinds.description: Node kinds whose search can turn this up. Empty (the default) means nowhere.

notes.description: Author commentary (JSON has no comments, ADR-0002).
